meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动生成一段可分享的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把手头的代码改动快速变成一段能分享的讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into a shareable narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn a repo's changes into a shareable explainer video

howto.what: 把 GitHub PR(PR 链接、owner/repo#N 或已检出仓库里的「this PR」)变成讲解这次代码改动的视频:抓取 diff、提交与文件,写脚本和分镜,最后渲染出 renders/video.mp4,风格固定为 code-editorial。
howto.when: 当你给出 GitHub PR(链接、owner/repo#N 或已检出仓库里的「this PR」)时接管,输入必须是代码改动;它不是产品宣传片,也不做没有 PR 的话题讲解。

say.text: 把 github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842 做成讲解视频
say.note: 抓取该 PR 的 diff 与提交,开始规划分镜

say.text: 解释一下 owner/repo#128 这个改动
用男声给这个 PR 视频配音
say.note: 指定男声,否则默认 Marcia / am_michael

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR') into a code-change explainer video: fetches the diff, commits and files, writes script and storyboard, then renders renders/video.mp4 in a fixed code-editorial style.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand it a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo). The input must be a code change; not a product promo and not a no-PR topic explainer.

say_en.text: Turn github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842 into an explainer video
say_en.note: Fetches the PR diff and commits, then plans the storyboard
Uses a changelog, feature, fix or refactor archetype

say_en.text: Narrate this PR video with a male voice
say_en.note: Picks a matching voice; default is Marcia / am_michael
